title: Dizon recruits Gab Go, says official to investigate EDSA busway overcharging
summary: Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon on Monday said he tasked incoming Assistant Secretary Gab Go to investigate reports of overcharging along the EDSA Busway.
